item.title: MSC 2026 Mobile Legends: Playoff Bracket and July 29–30 Match Schedule
item.description: TLPH and SRG are out, while Aurora stunned Group B. Here is the official MSC 2026 bracket, with every start time converted to Moscow time.
item.dc:creator: Boost MLBB Editorial Team
item.yandex:full-text:
The story in 30 seconds
The playoffs run from July 29 to 31, with the Grand Final on August 1.
Eight teams remain in the bracket; Team Liquid PH and Selangor Red Giants have been eliminated.
The quarterfinals and semifinals are best-of-five, while the final is best-of-seven.
The Mid Season Cup 2026 group stage ended with two major eliminations. Defending champion Team Liquid Philippines and last year’s runner-up Selangor Red Giants both missed the knockout stage. The eight remaining teams now enter a single-elimination bracket: one series loss ends their tournament.
MSC 2026 quarterfinal schedule in Moscow time
MOONTON published the match times in GMT+8. Below, they have been converted to Moscow time (MSK, UTC+3). Moscow is 5 hours behind, so 5 hours were subtracted from every time on the official posters.

Every quarterfinal and semifinal uses a BO5 format: a team must win three games to take the series. The Grand Final on August 1 will be BO7, with four wins required to become champion.
The highest-placed teams in each group earned the right to choose their opponent. Pick order was determined by game differential. Each favorite selected a familiar opponent it had already beaten in the group stage.
Why these teams were paired
Aurora surprised Group B as two favorites went out
Aurora Gaming’s run was the defining story of Group B. The team first defeated defending champion Team Liquid PH, then beat ONIC to finish first. TLPH never recovered from its opening loss and exited the tournament in its second match.
ONIC, meanwhile, fought back through the lower side of the group, eliminating Selangor Red Giants to claim a playoff spot. That makes Aurora versus ONIC a rematch—but this time, there is no room for error.
MSC has already passed two million concurrent viewers
According to Esports Charts, the group stage peaked at 2,010,159 concurrent viewers during ONIC versus SRG. That figure was current at publication time; with the playoffs and Grand Final still to come, the tournament’s final peak could climb higher.
